title: gator-policy-pin-v1
description: The committed record of which org policy versions were in force in a governed repo (.gator/policy-pin.json). The policy channel's Git proof surface (runtime-split Phase 5b, roadmap item 19): Enterprise's machine_policy_states answers fleet queries; this pin proves from git history alone what policy governed each commit. Written by `gator-enterprise policies pull` when run inside a governed repo. Content is NOT embedded — the content_hash is the proof; the control plane and ~/.gator/enterprise/org-policies.json hold the content. Additive-friendly per the contracts-layer invariant: additionalProperties stays true; removing or renaming a required field is a version bump.

schema.description: Schema tag. Readers MUST check this before interpreting other fields.

pulled_at.description: UTC timestamp of the pull that produced this pin.

pulled_by_machine.description: Machine id (~/.gator/machine-id `id:` field) of the pulling machine, or null. Informational.

policies.description: One entry per active org policy applied to this repo at pull time. Empty array is legal (org had no active policies).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the policy version's canonical JSON content (matches policy_versions.content_hash server-side).
